{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Remove them
data_clean = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now, compute conversion rates within each customer_segment, by channel
# This will allow us to compare the effect within strata

# Group by channel and customer_segment to get conversion rates
conversion_by_group = data_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Pivot to make it easier to compare
conversion_pivot = conversion_by_group.pivot(index='channel', columns='customer_segment', values='converted')

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment
# We want: (email - paid_search) for each segment

# First, get the conversion rate for email and paid_search in each segment
email_rates = conversion_pivot.loc['email']
paid_search_rates = conversion_pivot.loc['paid_search']

# Compute the difference within each segment
differences_by_segment = email_rates - paid_search_rates

# Print results
print("Conversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_pivot)
print("\nDifference (email - paid_search) within each segment:")
print(differences_by_segment)"}
